repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server uses internal account subjects for MQTT messages and session management. Leafnode connections can be assigned subject-level permissions.

### Problem Description

Broad internal MQTT subject exceptions also applied to leafnode connections. A restricted leafnode peer could bypass its allow list for MQTT traffic and control messages in its account. Depending on the available MQTT state, this could disclose message contents or allow interference with sessions and retained messages.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.9 and v2.15.2. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-gc58-jp35-x246>
 * Credit: Taeyoung Jeong (@ttzero25)
repo.summary: Leafnode permissions can be bypassed for internal MQTT subjects
